question: After the correctness defects are fixed, should OpenClaw accept an experimental agent-only Claw update executor before workspace, package, MCP, and cron update executors exist?
rationale: The executor can mechanically fail closed for unsupported owners, but exposing a partial grouped-update lifecycle is an RFC sequencing and product-contract decision.

options.title: Accept the narrow slice
options.body: Land the gated agent/provenance executor after the CAS fixes and prerequisite stack receive approval.

options.title: Wait for grouped updates
options.body: Keep the draft as prototype evidence until all grouped resource owners have a coordinated update lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow slice
recommendation.body: Land the gated agent/provenance executor after the CAS fixes and prerequisite stack receive approval.
